title: Navigation: one model, shown — four rules decided, 56 layouts marked retire

owner_note.text: The navigation questions are answered on one page with live demos: one left tree swapped only at a section root, headings on the right, links open in their own section, and workspace pages as a page kind. The alternative, one sidebar per level, leaves 0 px for content at 1200. 25 of 81 layout pages are kept and 56 are marked retire, but only Family tree has moved; the four core edits are written down, not made.
